svg.title: STANAG 5066 SIS: an S_BIND_REQUEST
svg.desc: The S_BIND_REQUEST of frame 25 of S5066-HFChat-1.pcap, 32 bits per row: the sync preamble 90 EB, version 0, a primitive size of 4, the PDU type 1, then the primitive itself, SAP 5 (HF Chat) and rank 1 in one byte, the service type byte 0x14 (ARQ, node delivery confirmation) and an unused byte; SisPdu keeps the SisHeader, the named type and the typed primitive.
